physical_scope: Isolated voltage-clamped dynamic gate process; physical-time continuous rates, external availability and explicit initial conductance. Coupled free-voltage production integration is not yet qualified.
compatibility_scope: Actual unmodified native Gap_Junction class with one or three calls per declared outer step, implicit updates, class-only initialization and stored-state blocking; the three-call mode represents the previously measured FULL-driver call policy, not a new full-driver run.
gpu_scope: CPU/L4 float64 function and complete gate-state replay qualification; no throughput target, multi-GPU scaling or biological validation.
